function: DDPG agent outputs the AP precoding matrix, STAR-RIS reflection and transmission amplitudes and phase shifts, and per-actuator packet error probabilities to maximize the finite-blocklength sum-rate (p. 6-7).
system: Downlink MU-MISO URLLC: AP with Nt antennas (Nt=4 default), energy-splitting STAR-RIS with M elements (M=8 default), K=6 single-antenna actuators; 2 GHz carrier (p. 4, 8, 9).
method: Reinforcement learning: DDPG actor-critic, actor with one 256-neuron hidden layer, critic 256/512, replay buffer, Adam, learning rate 1e-4; reward from sum-rate and PEP penalties (p. 6-8).
data_channel: Simulated channels: Rician AP-STAR-RIS link (Kr=3), Rayleigh AP-actuator and STAR-RIS-actuator links, power-law path loss; no standard model or dataset; DRL learns from interaction (p. 4-5, 8).
test_conditions: Agent trained and evaluated in one environment, random actuator positions; sweeps of M, Nt, Pmax, K, blocklength, PEP, CSI error; no reuse of a trained agent stated (p. 8-12).
baselines: BCD with high-SINR approximation (non-learned); without RIS, reflecting-only RIS, random phase shifts (DDPG variants of the proposed method); no earlier learned method (p. 8-9, 11).
metrics: Sum-rate (bps/Hz) at finite blocklength versus M, Nt, Pmax, K, blocklength and maximum PEP; running time (ms); sum-rate under CSI uncertainty q (p. 9-12).
complexity: Order O(LT|B|(layer-width products)) in Sec. IV-C; running time 26.59 ms (M=4) to 67.92 ms (M=64) versus BCD 181.67 to 1669.32 ms in Table III (p. 8, 11).
q1_support: p. 5: "it is assumed that these channels follow Rayleigh fading". Missing: no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel; custom Rician and Rayleigh simulator (p. 4).
q2_support: p. 8: "The impact of different system parameters on the system is analyzed, including the number of RIS elements, the number of AP antennas". Missing: state and action sizes depend on Nt, M, K (p. 7), no reuse of one trained agent is stated; the CSI-error sweep does not count.
q3_support: p. 11: "the proposed algorithm, the reflecting-only RIS algorithm, the random phase shifts algorithm and the algorithm without RIS have the same values for these three variables". Missing: only BCD is non-learned; the others are DDPG variants, no earlier learned method.
q4_support: p. 11: "we recorded the running time of these two algorithms, as shown in Table III" (order of complexity also given in Sec. IV-C, p. 8).
q5_support: p. 8: "K actuators are randomly distributed in the transmission or reflection space of the STAR-RIS". Missing: self-generated simulation, no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: STAR-RIS runs in energy-splitting mode (p. 4). Area 3: DDPG sets the AP precoder, STAR-RIS coefficients and packet error probabilities jointly (p. 7). q3=0 because the three non-BCD schemes reuse the same DDPG networks (p. 11), so they are variants of the proposed method.
